CFML Language Reference: Functions

StructSort

Returns an array of the structure's top-level keys, ordered by the values they hold, or by a value further down when each top-level value is itself a structure.

Category

Structure functions

Syntax

StructSort(base [, sortType [, sortOrder [, pathToSubElement]]])

Parameters

base
The structure whose keys are sorted.
sortType
"text" (the default, case-sensitive), "textnocase" or "numeric".
sortOrder
"asc" (the default) or "desc".
pathToSubElement
A dotted path such as "Salary" or "Info.Salary" that leads from each top-level value to the value to sort on.

Returns

An array of key names.

Usage

Every value sorted on must be a simple value, and a number for "numeric" sorting; otherwise the function throws an exception. Keys with equal values keep their original order.

Note  New in KoldFusion 4.5.1 SP2.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFQUERY NAME="Staff" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets" MAXROWS="6">
SELECT Emp_ID, LastName, Salary FROM Employees ORDER BY Emp_ID
</CFQUERY>
<CFSET People = StructNew()>
<CFLOOP QUERY="Staff">
  <CFSET People[LastName] = StructNew()>
  <CFSET People[LastName].Salary = Salary>
</CFLOOP>
<CFSET ByPay = StructSort(People, "numeric", "desc", "Salary")>
<OL>
<CFLOOP FROM="1" TO="#ArrayLen(ByPay)#" INDEX="i">
  <CFOUTPUT><LI>#ByPay[i]#: #DollarFormat(People[ByPay[i]].Salary)#</CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</OL>

See also

StructKeyArray, StructFindKey, ArraySort, ListSort
